specs.title: Limit Frame Rate to 60 FPS

specs.title: Siri AI (Ineligible Regions)
specs.detail: Experimental eligibility override by Project Linwood (mattisklein), available on iPhone 15 Pro and later with iOS 27. Verified upstream on iPhone 16 Pro, build 24A437; other devices and builds are untested. Mobile permits all iPhone models; devices without Apple Intelligence hardware are untested.
specs.warning: Requires an unencrypted protective backup and a reboot. Set Siri language to English (US), then complete consent in Settings. This replaces ALL existing eligibility overrides. Other builds are untested. Turning this switch off does not undo an applied override; use Reset Siri AI Overrides and apply.

specs.title: Reset Siri AI Overrides
specs.detail: Writes a valid empty eligibility override archive. This clears ALL eligibility overrides, including overrides installed by other tools.
specs.warning: This clears ALL eligibility overrides, not just Siri AI. It cannot recover a previous override map. Requires an unencrypted protective backup; apply and reboot.
